title: NVIDIA published its GDC 2026 GeForce RTX announcements
summary: On 2026-03-11 NVIDIA published a GeForce RTX announcement for GDC 2026. The supplied official NVIDIA link is classified on the DLSS 4.5 development line, so it should be retained as a historical milestone pending source-level review. The dated link alone does not establish the specific DLSS 4.5 features, availability, or performance claims.
